propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and lacks single authoritative parser/help source causing drift between handler-owned help and documented syntax
21 intercept-only commands lack safe canonical help and unknown-command handling returns inconsistent results
Runtime parsing and generated help must derive from the same side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory to eliminate manual syntax authority and docs-only grammar
Lazy route registry must preload overview and help bytes before operation/config/mount boundaries to keep help accessible without initialization side effects
Command spellings including exact aliases, compatibility forms, hidden variants, and retired commands must exhibit approved discovery and help behavior with predictable exit codes
Generated package-help and CLI reference artifacts must be byte-current and enumerate registries rather than source regexes or hand-maintained command censuses
